recall.minute: Model evaluation goes beyond accuracy. A guide such as scikit-learn's map chooses a starting estimator from data size, task, labels and data type. Deployed models must also meet fairness, accountability, transparency, privacy and security requirements. Models learn from historical data and can amplify its bias; COMPAS showed similar accuracy but unequal false-positive and false-negative rates across races. Fairness through unawareness, simply dropping sensitive features, fails because proxies leak them. Interpretability helps users, regulators and designers: trees give rules, linear models give coefficients (L1 makes them sparse), k-NN gives example neighbours, while the most accurate models tend to be least interpretable.
